waiting.title: The residents want it fixed
waiting.text: Rafe Osei is back for the residents. "Smell reaching 3 homes, still. It's costing us 5.4 points of happiness. Smell rides the corridors: a bulkhead on the corridor between smelly rooms (galleys, farms, composters, recycling) and the homes stops it, and so does distance. Will you do something about it?"
